name: Mordhau
texts: Thank you, I'm truly grateful to ya!
Stop, in the name of the law!
Your skull is even softer than your belly.
Aw what the hell was that for?
We fight under the same flag!
I'm getting beaten to a pulp!
You're pretty decked out mate! Compensating for something, are we?
My dear old granny fights better than you!
I've had rougher times in a brothel!
Not exactly cut out for this, are ya'?
I don't know what's going through your head pal, but you can forget it!
You sure like your armor! What are you hiding?
You're all hat and no kettle!
You're nothing but a rump-renting mug spout!
Looks like someone is after a bit of pain!
Come on! I can do this all day!
OH MY GOD! Look at these bloody amateurs!
Ya' arse look just about the right size for my boot!
I've just about had enough of your rubbish!
Make ya' move, sweet cheeks! It'll be ya' last!
You're nothing but dung splattered chamber pots!
Come on you chicken aughted gassers!
Well bugger me! You're a cut above the average, aren't ya'?
Not bad! You might actually be worth the effort!
Finally, someone with a bit of know-how!
Well, well. You actually know how to use that weapon!
They're all over us! Let's get out of 'ere!
I, uh, thought you were someone else?
Dammit, get out of the way then!
Uh, walk it off, you'll be fine.
What, I uh, I didn't do nothing!
Can't you recognize your own colours?
I'm on your side, you knave!
You pillock! You dare attack me?
Fathom this, you imbecile. I'm on your side!
I should draw and quarter you for that!
Touch me and I'll eviscerate you.
You'd best help me if you know what's good for you.
You will hold, or you will die!
This spot must be held at all costs!
You're a wretch, and you shall die a wretch!
Unkempt, unclean, and unworthy of existing.
Not even your own mother would want such a hideous fiend.
I can see you quake with fear.
I can smell the shit from your trousers! You quivering coward.
You are little more than worms and maggots.
Serfs don't belong on the battlefield!
I've seen cripples and lepers more capable!
I'll impale you upon my sword!
Come, men! Let us eradicate them!
The time of their defeat is now!
I shall rip out your entrails!
You will not escape my wrath!
Squeal and die like the pig you are.
Hm. Your sword arm is tolerable.
You're not as pathetic as some of these peasant rabble.
Someone worth a damn on this field, well done.
Lacking finesse, but you get the job done!
Flee, the enemy is upon us!
Your incompetence has routed us, fall back!
This skirmish may be theirs, but the battle will be ours!
It wasn't me, it was him!
Don't look at me like that, I'm not the cause of this!
You dare get in my way?
I'm not used to buffoons, my apologies!
I was trying to strike the enemy!
It's just a flesh would, you'll live.
You've earned my praise... for now.
Ah! I'm in deep flummery now!
No! Don't let them do this to me!
Ha! Your sword's looking a little short, sir!
You swing well, but miss terribly!
You're terrible! Look men, look how terrible he is!
Maybe you should take up farming!
Thy defense hath more holes than thy mother's swiss cheese!
The end is nigh for you!
You will fall by my blade (not used)
Never before have I seen such skill!
It is an honor to fight at your side!
I am humbled by your skills, sir!
Fall back! They've breached the liiine!
Thanks! I shan't soon forget it!
You are as kind as you are generous!
Watch where you aim that thing!
You fool! I'm on your side.
You fool I'm on your side!
Ahh! Oh, I'll get you for that!
Hello! It's good to see you!
Please sir, can you help me?
You are lower than a snake's belly!
Your bones are softer than a newborn child's.
You're a worthless lump of shit!
Let none of them breathe again!
None of you will see tomorrow!
You have the heart of a lion!
Uhh, apologies but you are in the way!
Apologies, but you are in the way!
My heart, uhh- weeps for you.
Anyone would think you want to get hit!
Thanks you! I won't forget this!
Oh it looks like I need help!
Ok, ok I've bitten off more than I can chew
Nope, nope nope I've changed my mind... Help!
Would someone mind awfully HELPING ME!
You sir, smell like something that was ejected from the backside of a diarrhetic horse!
You sir, are by far the worst soldier I have ever... smelled
Ugh! Shaking it more than twice is playing with it
You do actually know how to use that thing?
Look, don't feel bad, maybe you're just not cut out to be.. much of anything
No, no, you point it this way, you idiot
Are you just pretending to be a soldier?
No, by all means, keep swinging away, you'll eventually hit something
Well men, we trained hard, but looking upon the face of our enemy, I feel we needn't have trained quite so hard.
ah-heheheh, Where-where is the rest of your army?
Yoohoo, uh, we were supposed to fight an actual army, here. Uh, would you mind telling us where they've gone?
Do we really have to kill all of them? I was hoping to be done before tea
Ahoooy, ah, the dung-covered peasant convention is that way.
You call that an army? I've seen bigger book clubs!
I don't know what I was thinking
Well I hope this doesn't mean we can't be friends
What I'm trying to say is, thank you?
Just whose side do you think you're on?
Tell me you did not just mistake me for one of those corn-fed simpletons.
You just watch where you stick that thing!
I think it's time we fell back
If they get through, very bad things are going to happen to all of us
Yes, yes, pleased to meet you I'm sure
You're not half bad. Where did you study?
Your form, and execution, are exquisite
You know it's not every day I get to face a worthy opponent
You handle your weapon rather well, it's a shame I have to kill you
'Tis a rare thing to see a man who handles his weapon, as well as I do
Come on, kin, come on hyueeeeaaaaaahhhhhh!
Ha ha ha ha ha hah!
Ha ha ha ha ha hah, huh!
Fire at them, not at me, you clumsy fool!
Hit me again, and I will throw shit at you!
Haha, my grand-mère aims better than you, and she is blind!
My grand-mère aims better than you, and she is blind!
What is wrong with you? Do you have horse shit in your eyes?
Get your finger out of your derrière and fight properly!
It is my pleasure to meet you!
I am honoured to meet you!
Help me, I beg of you!
Who made your clothes? They are shit.
Go eat a donkey's dick, you peasant!
Sac de merde, why am I even speaking English? (note: this is incorrect; the actual expression is sac à merde)
Why am I even speaking English? Sac de merde!
Shut your mouth, or I will shit in it!
Let me make this simple for you: you are shit!
Shove it up your stinking foreign ass!
Where are your balls, hiding inside you?
Hahahah, where are your balls, hiding inside you?
You are not important to me!
If I cut you open, shit would pour out of your veins!
it's time to say, au revoir!
You have reached your hour of death!
You will be remembered for the fool that you are!
Hah, you can fight until your last breath, but you will never win!
Hahaha, You can fight until your last breath, but you will never win!
I have never seen such a strong fighter!
I can barely believe my own eyes!
It is an honour to fight beside you!
Fall back, they're closing in on us!
I'm sorry, get out of the way next time!
Oh, uh, pardon, pardon, my sincere apologies!
Sorry, but it was your own stupid fault!
Thank you, I am truly grateful!
Yes, my word is my honour!
Ah, to be sure to be sure!
Of cooourse! If I can't trust you, who can I trust?
No! No! No! You can fuck yourself sideways!
No I don't believe ye, ya pulled it out yer ass!
No way! You think I'm a fuckin idiot?
No way! You can take that and shove it up your arse if you think I'll go with that! huh!
No Way! That's right? You wanted some of this! We'll Handle it then!
No! There's no way that's happening!
You can feck off right now if you think I'll say yes to that!
I'd rather flush me gub out with shite water than agree to that!
Ah, I could do with some help over here to be sure!
Couldn't spare a little help over here? heh?
Aye, you got a moment to help a friend?
I'll be needing some help from someone! Anyone!
I'll be fecking doomed if someone doesn't help me soon!
I'm sanctified truly I am! but I need some help of me own!
They are fecking me over here!
Can anyone help me? They're fuckin' killing me!
You're foolin no-one! I can smell the shite in your kaks from here!
Look at the state of ye! And your mouths full of shite as well!
Go on! Run home to yer mammy!
Shut yer hole, ya fekin gobshite!
Call yerself a warrior? Your all over the show!
Call yerself a warrior? Your all over the shop!
You don't scare me you mouldy oul fucker!
Only yer mammy could love a face like that! heh!
Fek off will ya? Your more irritating than an itchy ass!
You really think ya can win this battle ya fuckin fool? You ain't got a chance!
Your pathetic, I've seen young weans fight better than you!
One strike from me and you'll be howling like a banshee so ya will!
Is that the best ya can give ya poor slob?
You need to back the fek down or you'll be getting a knuckle supper!
You need to back the fek down or you'll get a fist up yer arse!
You need to back the fek down or you'll get a fist to the face!
Are you starting? Well come on then I'll knock yer pan right now!
Shut the fek up you boring dry shite!
Don't piss on ym back and tell me it's raining! I'll beat the beef of ya!
Away ya go, wash the back of your bollocks before I rip em off! ey?
Ohh it was an accident, don't eat the head off me!
Fair play, I'm sorry! But you were in the way so you were!
I'm sorry ok, your not exactly dead on yourself!
Shut the fek up, I'm sorry all right?
Ah it's just a scratch, I'm sorry!
Ah grab a hold of yourself, it's just a scratch!
Sorry, wh-why am I saying sorry? You need to get yerself out of the fuckin way!
Ah baby Jesus I'm sorry! I don't know what's got into me today!
I'm very thankful so I am!
Thank you! Maybe I'll return the favour one day eh? or maybe not.
Christ almighty! What ya hittin' me for?
What ya think your doing? Anyone'd think your steaming!
For feksake! I'm not the enemy!
Stop actin the maggot and fight them!
I'm on your side ya fekin eeijit!
What the hell is wrong with you?! Your fighting arseways!
Aye the yoke is that way! you daft cow!
Jesus, Mary and Joseph and the little wee donkey, what the fuck are you doing!
We should take a wee step back!
It's no good, we need to leg it now!
We need to get the fek outta here!
There's fek all we can do, retreat!
Retreaaat! we'll get the fekers next time!
You useless bastards can't hold em! Retreat!
Defend this spot, I'll be feking raging if we lose it!
Stand your ground you bunch of arseweeds!
We need to hold here, your pathetic lives are counting on it!
It's squeaky arse time for you, now hold yer ground!
Hold steadfast, we can't lose this ground!
Top of the morning to ye!
Well hello there, what's the story?
Who in the name of Jesus are you?
You should follow me, so ye should!
Keep up lad! Don't you be lagging behind!
This waaay! What ya waiting for?
Come on now! These legs won't walk themselves!
Eh you fight well so ye do!
Yer dead on so ye are!
I never expected the likes of you could fight so well!
Cracking fight so it was, I almost broke a sweat!
Well done, it's been a while since I met me match!
You've the face of a bare shabby arse now, but you fight like one too!
You've the face of a bare shabby arse now, but you fight like him too oh, hehehe!
